title: Enhancing Multiple Dimensions of Trustworthiness in LLMs via Sparse Activation Control

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by presenting the model with multiple-choice questions regarding ideological, cultural, or lifestyle preferences and calculating the Refusal Rate (RR) using keyword detection to ensure the model appropriately remains neutral and refuses to express subjective preferences.
Evaluated mechanistically by measuring the change in output logits during path patching to identify specific attention heads causally responsible for stereotypical associations.
